newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 31.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China Vice Premier Zhu Rongji inspected state-owned enterprises in the northern province of Liaoning to seek ways to help them halt losses.
- A spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation said the fall in foreign investment in the first half of the year was in line with the government's tight monetary policy.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China set up a joint import and export company with a South Korean company holding 49 percent stake of the total 100 million yuan ($12 million) registered capital.
